reasoning_content: AWS CLI 1.22.34 is old but works. Create 3 buckets with the S3 endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9000, path-style access, and set a lifecycle policy with expire-days 30 on the validation bucket (as suggested in the guide).

action.command:
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xplanbox AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xplanbox
aws --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:9000 s3api create-bucket --bucket xplan-attachments
aws --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:9000 s3api create-bucket --bucket xplan-validation
aws --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:9000 s3api create-bucket --bucket xplan-mapproxycache
aws --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:9000 s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket xplan-validation --lifecycle-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ID":"expire-30-days","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":30}}]}'
echo "=== buckets ==="
aws --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:9000 s3api list-buckets | python3 -c "import json,sys; [print(b['Name']) for b in json.load(sys.stdin)['Buckets']]"
